system.description:
As a Swift Action, you can make a DC 15 Knowledge (Tactics) check. If the check succeeds, you know which allies and opponents in your line of sight are reduced to at least half of their maximum total Hit Points.

If you succeed at both a DC 15 Knowledge (Tactics) check and a DC 15 Use Computer check, you may use this Talent to determine what Vehicles are reduced to at least half their maximum Hit Points.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Core Rulebook
